title: VideoEditor-MoE: Scaling Complex Video Editing with Mixture of Experts
abstract: arXiv:2611.03043v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Complex video editing requires understanding complex instructions while jointly fulfilling multiple editing requests. Meeting these demands through dense model scaling substantially increases computational cost. We introduce VideoEditor-MoE, the first open-source mixture-of-experts framework for video editing. Beyond sparse MLP-MoE layers, MoE-Attention expands attention capacity through routed key--value experts while preserving global interactions among video tokens. Initialized from a 5B video editing model, VideoEditor-MoE scales to 14B and 56B parameters, with approximately 8B parameters activated per token in both variants. Comparisons with existing methods and two complementary baselines, Explicit-MoE and MLP-MoE, assess its benefits over explicit expert guidance and MLP-only expert architectures. Further analyses demonstrate that all experts remain active and reveal that learned routing responds more strongly to sample

translated_title: VideoEditor-MoE：基于混合专家模型扩展复杂视频编辑能力
translated_abstract: 复杂视频编辑需要在理解复杂指令的同时，共同完成多个编辑请求。若通过稠密模型扩展来满足这些需求，将大幅增加计算成本。我们提出了VideoEditor-MoE，这是首个面向视频编辑的开源混合专家框架。除了稀疏的MLP-MoE层之外，MoE-Attention通过路由的键-值专家扩展了注意力容量，同时保留了视频token之间的全局交互。VideoEditor-MoE从一个5B参数的视频编辑模型初始化，可扩展至14B和56B参数，且两个变体中每个token仅激活约8B参数。通过与现有方法以及两个互补基线的比较，评估了其相对于显式专家指导和纯MLP专家架构的优势。进一步的分析表明所有专家均保持活跃状态，并揭示了学习到的路由机制对样本（原文此处似乎被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了首个开源的视频编辑混合专家框架VideoEditor-MoE，通过MoE-Attention和稀疏专家层将模型从5B扩展至56B参数（每个token仅激活约8B），在显著降低计算成本的同时提升了复杂多指令视频编辑能力。
en_tdlr: VideoEditor-MoE is the first open-source mixture-of-experts framework for video editing, scaling from 5B to 56B parameters (with only ~8B activated per token) through MoE-Attention and sparse expert layers, enabling complex multi-instruction video editing while substantially reducing computational cost.
